==Description==
'''Nimble''' is a status effect that makes an enemy twice as fast.

==Mechanics==
'''Nimble''' makes any enemy with it twice as fast.

==Enemy List==
These following event enemies have '''Nimble''':
*[[Hex Mimic]] (''Panic Mode'' only, [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]])

The [[Speedy Enemies]] modifier gives every enemy '''Nimble'''. Similarly, all enemies in the [[Vanguard (Challenge)|Vanguard]] challenge map spawn with the '''Nimble''' attribute due to the [[Vanguard (Modifier)|Vanguard]] modifier.

Enemies can receive '''Nimble''', even if they did not spawn with it if they are hit by a gift explosion created by the [[Jack Frost]]'s ''Subzero Tricks'' ability and by the [[Hex Weaver]] with its ''Spooky Tricks'' ability. The [[Energy Drink]] consumable also applies '''Nimble''' to the next three enemies sent by a player. In the [[Null & Void Event]], if the [[Death]] curse was selected, all enemies would spawn with '''Nimble'''.

==Tower & Unit List==
Although no known use on towers for this attribute exists, the following towers used to have '''Nimble''':
*[[Golden Snowballer]]

==Update History==
*'''3 May 2024''' - [[v1.20.0]]
**'''Nimble''' added.
**{{Bug}} When a burn, chillness, stun, [[Toxic Gunner]] poison or [[DJ Booth]] slowdown effect is applied to a '''Nimble''' enemy, the enemy loses the speed increase from '''Nimble''' once the effect ends.
*'''4 November 2024''' - [[v1.39.0|v1.39.7]]
**{{Bugfix}} All effects no longer cause enemies to lose their speed increase from '''Nimble''' once the effect ends.
